content:
The meeting must be scheduled on Monday since Doris is busy all day on Tuesday (from 9:00 to 17:00). On Monday, both participants have free time, but Doris prefers not to meet after 14:00. Jean is free all day on Monday, as no constraints were provided for Jean on that day.

Doris's busy times on Monday are:
- 9:00 to 11:30
- 12:00 to 12:30
- 13:30 to 16:00
- 16:30 to 17:00

This results in the following free time slots on Monday within the 9:00 to 17:00 work hours:
- 11:30 to 12:00 (30 minutes)
- 12:30 to 13:30 (60 minutes)
- 16:00 to 16:30 (30 minutes)

The meeting duration is 30 minutes, so all slots are sufficient. However, to respect Doris's preference to avoid meeting after 14:00, the slots after 14:00 (16:00 to 16:30) should be avoided. The available slots before 14:00 are:
- 11:30 to 12:00
- 12:30 to 13:00 (a subset of 12:30 to 13:30)
- 13:00 to 13:30 (a subset of 12:30 to 13:30)

Any of these 30-minute slots work for both participants. The slot from 12:30 to 13:00 is chosen as it provides a buffer after Doris's meeting ending at 12:30 and before her next meeting at 13:30, making it less rushed.

Thus, the meeting is scheduled for Monday from 12:30 to 13:00.

```json
{"time_range": "{12:30:13:00}", "day": "Monday"}
```
